question: 5 clients that purchased the most hashicorp products during 2024
gold_cypher: MATCH (cl:Client)-[o:OPPORTUNITY]->(p:Product) WHERE o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won' AND (toLower(p.vendor) CONTAINS 'hashicorp' OR toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'hashicorp') AND o.close_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.close_date < '2025-01-01' WITH cl.sf_name as client, count(DISTINCT p) as product_count, count(o) as deal_count, sum(toFloat(o.total_price)) as total_spent ORDER BY product_count DESC, total_spent DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN client, product_count, deal_count, total_spent

question: top 3 products with succesfull deals during 2023
gold_cypher: MATCH (c:Client)-[o:OPPORTUNITY]->(p:Product) WHERE o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won' AND o.close_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.close_date < '2024-01-01' WITH p.name as product, count(o) as deal_count, sum(toFloat(o.total_price)) as total_revenue ORDER BY deal_count DESC, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN product, deal_count, total_revenue

question: top 3 products with succesfull deals during 2023 and list client names with their accociated deal names
gold_cypher: MATCH (c:Client)-[o:OPPORTUNITY]->(p:Product) WHERE o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won' AND o.close_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.close_date < '2024-01-01' WITH p.name as product, count(o) as deal_count ORDER BY deal_count DESC LIMIT 3 WITH collect(product) as top_products MATCH (c:Client)-[o:OPPORTUNITY]->(p:Product) WHERE o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won' AND o.close_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.close_date < '2024-01-01' AND p.name IN top_products RETURN p.name as product, collect({client: c.sf_name, deal: o.opportunity_name}) as deals ORDER BY size(deals) DESC

question: top 5 products with succesfull deals during 2025 and list client names with their accociated deal names and deal price and gross profit

question: top 3 selling products of all time, list product name, product vendor and avg deal profit

question: top 5 employees with the most deals during 2025, show names deal amount and total profit

question: 4 top selling vendors during 2024-2025 , vendor names and list of products sold by name and ammount
